jobs_results.title: Business Intelligence & Consumer Insights Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Overview

Are you interested in a career in Insights in PepsiCo?

Then now is the time to explore the opportunities of PepsiCo: join us as the next Business Intelligence & Consumer Insights Analyst.

Working with inspiring and experienced colleagues, you'll find that the atmosphere in our office in Lisbon/Madrid/Barcelona is informal and engaging. With an active, get-things-done culture, this is a place where your dynamism and agility will make a difference.

Your mission:

In this role you be a source of Competitive Advantage for PepsiCo that drives sustainable results by creating, stimulating and monetizing demand and enabling better decisions across the enterprise. The mission is to move from knowledge generators to decision change agents by relentlessly pursuing decisions that have a material impact on the business and advocating for the best actions to improve PepsiCo odds of success.

Responsibilities

Your day to day with us:
• Grounds & informs for Portugal market and Gazpacho... IBP (Integrated Business Planning) process, delivering systematic trends and robust situation assessments that identify and prioritise market and portfolio/brand growth issues/opportunities
• Champion performance analytics for Gazpacho & Portugal Snacks and Beverages category: give holistic market and portfolio perspective thru multisource data with clear diagnostic sharing insights in order to support strategy definition and influence the business decisions taken both in PSP/ACP process as in day to day business.
• Translates data into actionable insights across all dimensions (categories, brands, shoppers, competitors, channels and customers) unlocking insights to define strategies that ensure growth.
• Helping to execute the brand/portfolio Learning Plans for Portugal (study by study execution and supporting the Marketing brand teams in bringing insights to life)
• Support the execution of Portugal Insights consumer projects focused on Brand Building, Innovation, Market place Insights in close partnership with research and creative agencies.
• Fuel NRM Strategy with insights ensuring consumer centricity
• Conduct consumer insights studies and provide insights to impact brands strategy and NRM agenda

Qualifications

What will you need to succeed?
• Strong analytical skills, being able to synthetize and integrate multiple sources seing the connection between different data and trends with a very good balance with business and commercial drive.
• Proven track record in understanding consumer insights and business insights and forecasting skills.
• 3 years of experience in Insights related functions (Consumer, Shopper Insights or Business Analytics), using qualitative and quantitative tools within the FMCG industry preferably.
• Prior experience in management of agency relationships
• Strong communication skills
• Experience and use of continuous market research tools (e.g. Kantarworldpanel, Nielsen, IRI)
• Fluent in English

What makes us different?
• Hybrid working model: combination of remote and collaborative office experience to enable innovation
• Flexible work schedules & Work-life balance
• Variety of benefits to support your physical, emotional and financial wellbeing
• Professional growth possibilities & learning opportunities

Being you at PepsiCo:

PepsiCo is an equal opportunity employer, committed to helping people lead healthier lives and supports workforce diversity. We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability.

Planet + People:

PepsiCo Positive (pep+) is how we’ll transform the way we create value by operating within planetary boundaries and inspiring positive change for the planet and people in the global food system

jobs_results.title: Especialista Big Data
jobs_results.description:
En NTT Data Murcia seguimos en proceso de expansión y apostando por los profesionales más cualificados, tanto locales como más allá de nuestra Región. Buscamos talento, ofreciendo teletrabajo desde el primer día y con todas las ventajas que supone formar parte de una de las mayores compañías de desarrollo de software a nivel mundial.

Toma nota, porque esto es sólo el principio:

- Apostamos por la estabilidad laboral ofreciendo contratación indefinida desde el primer día.

- Tú decides hacia dónde quieres orientar tu carrera profesional, pudiendo escoger entre la especialización tecnológica o la gestión de personas.

- Diversas opciones de flexibilidad horaria para que puedas conciliar tu vida personal y laboral.

- Acceso a formaciones adaptadas a las necesidades reales del centro. Ponemos a tu disposición cursos tanto de desarrollo de competencias técnicas como transversales, para desarrollar proyectos de una manera más eficaz.

Por último, dentro de NTT DATA creemos en la fuerza... de la diversidad y la inclusión, reconociendo que cada persona aporta una perspectiva única e invaluable a nuestro equipo. Por tanto, trabajamos para eliminar barreras y promover oportunidades equitativas para el crecimiento profesional, asegurando el tener acceso a las mismas posibilidades de desarrollo.

Requisitos:

Experiencia y conocimientos en lenguajes de programación Scala, Java o Python (PySpark) implementados sobre el framework de procesamiento distribuido Spark.

· Valorable nivel alto de inglés (mínimo B2).

· Capacidad de análisis, diseño y desarrollo de soluciones de tratamiento del dato.

· Mantenimiento de la interlocución con miembros del proyecto como parte del soporte en la definición e implementación de requisitos.

· Valoraremos experiencia en la gestión y liderazgo de equipos de trabajo

jobs_results.title: Business Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Main Responsibilities
• Must be a key member of Customer Excellence, working cross-functionally to deliver value added insights related Customer Engagement for decision making and be a trusted partner for Affiliate brand teams and leadership. Develop a deep understanding of data assets and Ontology in Analytical Framework (Foundry) to define data entities and objects requirements and brief the Data Engineering team to create the appropriate environments.
• Understand and assess data fit and quality, informing data engineers to maintain the highest data standards.
• Drive the engagement metrics and dashboard of the affiliate and drive the development of the use cases to prototype and develop the relevant visualizations. Transform data into business insights that are useful for decision making and strategic planning utilizing complex statistical models and algorithms using Analytical Framework.
• Deep understanding and knowledge of Analytical Framework to develop advanced analytics and... be able to generate ad-hoc queries to answer business requirements and extend best practices across the organization.
• Work closely with Business Technology Solutions colleagues to ensure smooth transition of pilots into production, on time, accurately, and in accordance with financial and ethical compliance guidelines.

Skills & Qualifications

Qualifications: A relevant bachelor’s degree in data engineering, data science, mathematics, statistics or economics. An MBA will be advantageous, but not required.

Work Experience: +4 years working in market research, business analytics, data analyst, data engineering or data science roles.

Technical Skills: Ability to operate Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) with advanced tools and process in multiple environments. Experience with data analysis, proficiency with SQL beneficial. Ability to define use cases and develop high-quality visualizations to provide an excellent user experience. Analyzing and drawing insights from key internally generated and external data sets. Demonstratable skills in either Javascript , SQL and Python. Preferred but not required expertise in visualization libraries/tools such as plotly, ggplot. Demonstratble competency required in at least one of the following visualization tools: Tableau, Power BI or Qlik sense. Foundry-related skills and experience (desired), including data preparation, pipeline inputs and development and visualization using Foundry Apps (monocle, forms, workshop, slate, etc). Able perform project management activities to align stakeholders' expectations.

Behavioral Attributes: Analytical skills, curiosity, business acumen, and creativity in problem solving. Strong communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with/present to (verbally and in writing) all levels of the organization (up to Affiliates GM) with the elaboration of a stroytelling . Adaptable to changing business conditions, strong collaboration, and teamwork across functional groups to contribute to a productive work culture. Lead strategically and create trust and respect within the department

jobs_results.title: Consultor/a Business Intelligence
jobs_results.description:
¡Nuestro equipo de Data en INETUM sigue creciendo! Buscamos incorporar CONSULTORES BI con los siguientes requisitos:

-Titulación mínima: Titulación universitaria o equivalente homologada en España.

-Experiencia mínima:
• Experiencia profesional de al menos 3 años en servicios, programas y proyectos TIC.
• Experiencia de más de 3 años en gestión de proyectos de implantación de sistemas a medida y módulo de datos Business Intelligence.
• Experiencia de más de 3 años en Metodología Business Intelligence y modelización de datos en entornos Data Warehouse, en diseño y creación de informes operativos, en herramientas relacionadas con el módulo de Business Intelligence, en el diseño y creación de Dashboards, informes y gráficos de modelos de analítica simple y avanzada y en tecnologías de desarrollo y control de versiones (GIT, RTC o similares).

-Amplio conocimiento en:
• Herramientas BI (como, por ejemplo: Cognos, PowerBI, SAP BI, Qlik y similares) .
• Elaboración de informes y... documentación de procesos, recopilación, transformación y carga (ETL) de datos, procedimientos de análisis e interpretación de resultados.
• Implementación de soluciones integrales BI.
• Bases de datos, modelizado, gestión, supervisión y análisis de datos.

Modalidad de trabajo: 100% presencial en las oficinas del cliente en Madrid capital.

¿Qué podemos ofrecerte?:
• Retribución salarial acorde con la experiencia aportada
• Plan de carrera: ofrecemos una atractiva carrera profesional en función de la experiencia y potencial personal dentro de una compañía en continua evolución y con un sólido crecimiento
• Plan de formación en competencias tecnológicas de acuerdo con las exigencias de los proyectos y clientes.
• Retribución flexible: te ofrecemos una retribución a la carta pudiendo elegir diferentes productos y modelar tú mismo cómo distribuirlos: seguro de salud, tickets de comida, guardería, tarjeta transporte, etc.
• Flexibilidad horaria.

Sobre INETUM, A Positive Digital Flow:

Somos un consultora digital, internacional y ágil. En la era de la post-transformación digital, nos esforzamos para que cada uno de nuestros 28.000 profesionales pueda renovarse continuamente viviendo positivamente su propio flow digital. Nuestros 28.000 atletas digitales están orgullosos de haberse certificado Top Employer Europe 2024. Con su perfil multi-experto, Inetum ofrece a sus clientes una combinación única de proximidad, organización sectorial y soluciones de última generación. Presente en más de 27 países, el Grupo tiene cerca de 28.000 empleados y en 2023 generó unos ingresos de 2.400 millones de euros.

Únete a INETUM. Vive tu Positive Digital Flow

jobs_results.title: Senior Product Analyst - Data Analytics (All genders)
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

More than 20 years ago, zooplus was one of the first to bring the pet category into the world of eCommerce. Today, we stand strong as Europe’s leading online pet platform, delivering moments of happiness to more than 9 million pet parents each year.

Job Description

As a Senior Product Analyst at zooplus, you'll serve as the advanced analytics service-provider for our product teams, domains, and verticals within the CPO division. You'll take ownership of the entire analytics pipeline for your assigned stakeholders, from provisioning analytical data (e.g., via analytical data marts) to crafting reports, designing dashboards, conducting data analysis, creating visualizations, generating insights, and offering actionable recommendations.

Your role involves close collaboration with designated product areas, understanding their unique business goals and challenges. You'll ensure that the insights you uncover are fully aligned with our product strategy and objectives... When necessary, you'll coordinate with relevant colleagues to ensure data generation and collection meet your requirements, ensuring you have all the necessary data to perform your analyses effectively.

You'll play a pivotal role in fostering a data-driven culture within zooplus. By sharing your insights with your assigned product area and business teams, you'll empower them to make informed decisions. Additionally, you'll provide training to team members, enabling them to independently access and utilize reporting data, further strengthening our data-driven approach.

Key responsibilities:
• Full ownership of the end-to-end analytics service pipeline for the designated stakeholders.
• Digging deep into the product-specific datasets in order to provide actionable insights.
• Periodic presentation of your findings for all the key-stakeholders with your recommendations for action.
• Work together with other analysts in your department sharing your findings and presenting your work
• Being the specialist of your product domains' data and providing support regarding this data across other analysts
• Guiding less senior team members in their day-to-day work, and acting as the Team Lead's deputy when required
• Having the overview of analyses and research conducted in other product teams, recommending relevant analyses and experiments to further test the hypotheses arising from the work being done within these teams
• Assisting in evaluating product-related hypotheses arising from user research
• Periodic communication of key-findings to upper management, and continuous development of the team's communication approach
• Further development of the team in alignment with the Team Lead and/or Head of Department

Qualifications
• Advanced analytical understanding and critically thinking mindset
• Strong understanding of product management ideally in e-commerce contact, and its KPIs
• Combination of 5 years of experience in a modern product development environment with a data analytical focus.
• Proven track record of leading major analytics projects that impacted the whole company
• Excellent analytical and statistical skills based on several years of working experience
• Ability to combine insights from various different sources and products
• Ability to present complex datasets in an understandable way, and adjusting the communication based on the tech knowledge of the different audiences
• Expert-level developing dashboards / using Tableau, Power BI or similar tools
• Expert-level knowledge of Adobe Analytics or similar tools (for digital customer-facing products)
• Advanced SQL knowledge
• Good knowledge of statistical program packages (e.g. using Python or R)
• First steps in project & team leadership
• Good to have a Bachelors or Masters degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Science or similar

Additional Information

With more than 1,000 passionate professionals located across 10 European offices, we believe our success comes from working together and leveraging our international strengths. Expect to work in a hybrid environment, collaborating with colleagues in different locations remotely.

Our benefits:

🐾 20% discount in our zooplus shop

📖 Internal and external training

🎈 Team events

✈️ 28 Annual Vacation Days

🩺 Private Medical Health Insurance

⏰ Hybrid working model (up to 40% remote)

Want to know more? Learn more about who we are and what we do and visit our LinkedIn company profile.

zooplus is committed to equal opportunity. We value and embrace diversity and inclusion of all Team Members

jobs_results.title: Data Scientist
jobs_results.description:
Summary
• To provide analytical support to the BPA team for financial reporting, compliance and accuracy of data. To handle and coordinate the preparation of reports, ensuring a timley submission.

About The Role

Major accountabilities:
• Provide analytical support to managers in matters related to financial activities, decision making and general projects.
• Assist more senior colleagues in providing analysis in order to support the business planning and forecasting process and alignment across the organization.
• Contribute to the preparation of analysis and reports to enable the development of strategic long-term financial and business plans through the provision of accurate data and analysis.
• Support the preparation of reports on relevant facts and figures findings.
• Support the preparation of written project proposals, analytical reports, and presentations.
• Provide administrative support for the monthly BPA closing procedure and Business Unit (BU) management reporting... packages.
• Provide assistance to BPA Projects at country or BU level.
• Reporting of technical complaints / adverse events / special case scenarios related to Novartis products within 24 hours of receipt -Distribution of marketing samples (where applicable)

Key performance indicators:
• Internal customer satisfaction with quality, appropriateness, and timeliness of financial analyses provided -Reliability and accuracy of all figures delivered

Minimum Requirements:

Work Experience
• Operations Management and Execution.

Skills:
• Analytical Thinking and Financial Modeling.
• Effective communication.

Languages :
• English.

Why Novartis: Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture

Join our Novartis Network: Not the right Novartis role for you? Sign up to our talent community to stay connected and learn about suitable career opportunities as soon as they come up: https://talentnetwork.novartis.com/network

jobs_results.title: Junior Data Scientist
jobs_results.description:
The Opportunity

As a Junior Data Scientist, you will be joining our Analytics department working on a hybrid basis in Madrid. This role requires a high degree of proficiency in both Spanish and English and we would invite you to submit your application in English.

You will play a crucial role in helping us achieve our goals and deliver success on behalf of our customers by building advanced statistical models and algorithms that infer and predict individual customer behaviours in real-time, based on retail, online and ecommerce transaction data.

We are experiencing a continued period of great success winning big deals with customers in Latin America, as well as across the EMEA region. This has been a big factor in our decision to build an Analytics presence in Spain to support our customers. For this role you will be working with global customers that require periodic work outside of standard hours (evening work) and international travel around once a quarter.

Day to Day
•... Applying analytical theory to diverse real-world problems on large and dynamic datasets
• Generating integral work products from project kick-off through to live deployment
• Contributing to the development of statistical models and algorithms for integration within Featurespace products
• End-to-end processing and modelling of large customer data sets
• Producing materials to feedback analytic output to customers (reports, presentations, visualizations)
• Working collaboratively with customers to develop and optimize models tailored to their data
• Evaluating and improving analytical results on live systems
• Developing an understanding of industry data structures and processes
• Working with engineering/development teams to support and enhance the analytical infrastructure
• Testing analytical models and their integration within the ARIC platform

About you

Must haves:
• Good degree in a scientific or numerate discipline (e.g. Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Engineering) or equivalent work experience
• Strong, clear, concise written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish
• Evidence of interest in machine learning
• Experience in utilising statistical models and analytical algorithms in software
• Experience using Python, Java, R or another major programming language for data analysis, machine learning or algorithm development
• Technical and analytical skills with the ability to pick up new technologies and concepts quickly
• Problem-solving skills (especially in data-centric applications)
• Strong communication skills
• Ability to manage and prioritise personal workload

Great to haves:
• Exposure to the handling of large, diverse, real-world data sets
• Experience working in a Linux command line environment
• Experience using SQL to analyse data
• Experience with version control software and workflows (e.g. git)

Equal Opportunities

Here at Featurespace we are committed to being a place of equality, inclusion and respect to provide a safe environment for you to bring your authentic self to work. We know that we gain as much strength from our differences as we do our similarities. We value diversity and are dedicated to listening and learning from each other to build and maintain a positive and productive culture. We appreciate this will be an ever-evolving focus for the business to ensure everyone feels supported and has a sense of belonging

jobs_results.title: DATA Scientist- Supply Chain
jobs_results.description:
At the SEAT:CODE we are constantly looking for talented people willing to join our projects. Our start-up environment is very open minded, we love to test and implement new ideas. If you think you are ready to enjoy your work and be part of our big family, we invite you to keep reading what we think it could be a good fit for our current needs 😊.

The Data Scientist role 🤔
• Develop solutions using a range of data science techniques
• Implement and understand a range of data science techniques and be able to develop models including machine learning
• Collaborate with the team to develop data science solutions according to business needs
• Perform analytics on data
• Able to recognise and exploit business opportunities to ensure more efficient and effective performance of organisations
• Develop data science solutions that are fit for purpose, resilient, scalable and future-proof, to meet user needs
• Help team to achieve their goals and be aligned to business needs.

About The Team... 🤗
• Our technical Team loves to deliver really well-crafted solutions at decent speed. We love tech so we really give great attention to the technology (Technology as first class Citizen)
• We know that small, empowered, self-motivated teams can do big things.
• We like to measure everything, so we are always improving, for that we use the best tools on the market such as Datadog.
• Finally, we promote a culture of no blame, trust, and learning, and we support the mantra “if it hurts do it more often” so good CI and CD are really key for us.

What We Offer 🤩
• Possibility to work remotely within Spain (you can work from any city of Spain 😎)
• 2.000€ per year in social benefits to choose from: restaurant, kindergarten, health Insurance, private insurance, fuel, transportation, gym pass, cleaning services, WIFI, Holaluz contract, etc.
• 2.000€ per year in trainings
• Free language courses
• Daily Snacks: We try to promote healthy living habits. You will find in our canteen many nuts, fresh fruit, salads, ...
• Flexible working hours: We understand the importance of work-life balance.
• Short Fridays
• 26 days for your vacations
• Best technology for your needs
• Nice located offices in Poblenou

Minimum Requirements

What we are expecting from you 🥰
• At least 3 years of experience working with Python and SQL.
• At least 3 years of experience working with Industrial optimization and simulation projects.
• Experience with AWS services like Sagemaker and S3 at least. Glue and lambda knowledge would be a plus
• Knowledge on Git
• Research background
• Methodical and logical approach along with creativity when approaching a problem
• Knowledge on how to apply statistical methods including exploratory analysis and statistical testing to a specific data set
• Be able to obtain conclusions from a data set
• Able to log, analyse and manage problems to identify and implement the appropriate solution
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to identify and communicate data driven insights in a clear and effective manner
• Curiosity and thirst for knowledge
• Advocate for feedback
• Actively pursue improving skills
• Collaborate with others for learning and achieving goals together
• Generative AI
• Occasional availability to work at the offices in Martorell

jobs_results.title: Data Scientist
jobs_results.description:
Join our dynamic consulting teams at Globalpraxis and embark on a thrilling journey towards business excellence. We are seeking talented individuals who are passionate about leveraging data science to unlock the full potential of top FMCG businesses. As a Data Scientist, you will be a key part of our consulting teams and fully-embedded to the project role.

Details:
• Start date: ASAP
• Location: Barcelona, Spain

Responsibilities: As an integral part of our project teams, you will collaborate closely with our experts to tackle diverse data challenges and immerse yourself in the daily operations of the project. Your key responsibilities will include, within each project:
• Acquiring, cleansing, and standardizing large-scale datasets.
• Conducting in-depth analyses of complex business scenarios.
• Designing and implementing powerful predictive algorithms for various scenarios.
• Generating actionable insights and user-friendly reports that empower our clients to harness the true... potential of their data.
• Lead other analysts in more junior positions.

Requirements: To thrive in this role, we expect you to have the following qualifications:
• At least 2 years of demonstrable experience in data analytics / data science.
• Master's degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Computer Sciences, Mathematics, Statistics, or Engineering.
• Proficiency in English and Spanish.
• Advanced proficiency in R and/or Python.
• Knowledge and/or experience in PowerBI is considered a plus.
• Experience working with relational databases, including strong SQL query-building skills.

Desired Skills: In addition to the specific qualifications, we value the following skills and attributes:
• Strong analytical skills and a knack for problem-solving.
• Excellent architectural thinking to develop innovative solutions.
• Structured and critical thinking abilities to approach complex challenges.
• Strong interpersonal skills and alignment with our company culture.
• A collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in a multicultural environment.

Globalpraxis is a renowned international consulting firm known for our blend of academic expertise and dedicated consultants who foster objectivity, creativity, and intellectual rigor. With a strong presence in consumer goods, telecommunications, transportation, pharmaceuticals, and service industries, our strategies in consumer engagement, distribution channels, and customer-centricity have propelled our clients toward global success. With a global reach spanning Europe, Asia, Africa, and the United States, we combine analytical rigor with local insights to become the perfect partner for businesses worldwide.

Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to make a lasting impact on businesses and launch your career forward. Apply now to be a part of our exciting and vibrant team at Globalpraxis
